title: Verified Sylvester step certificates and prime chain: universal11.5 remainder

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic-field family defined by proof.md and family.py. At actual length N enumerate primes2<=k<=N, r=ceil(N/k) and r-1 with r>=3,k>r+1, m=min(N,rk), ignored p=N-m, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+E0+1 from disperser.md Sections12--13, B=t(t+3)/2<=d<m, and choose the minimum(4p+8d-4B-3,k,t,p) including the zero option(4N,0,0,0). Construct Q_k by the supplied deterministic prime-degree specialization of Shoup in field.md and irreducible_prime(k), ignore p actual input bits, and evaluate the descending-power order-t symmetric polynomial on the remaining m bits over F2[Z]/Q_k with zero padding. No field-polynomial bits or advice are inputs.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This ONE fixed total deterministic-field language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. The supplied prime-degree constructor, PRIME-DEGREE coefficient-isolation/zero-deficit theorem and full-B2 elimination establish C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N at EVERY actual integer N>=0 for the exact total selector in family.py. Sections8--10 prove for EVERY integer N>=0 that L_N<=(23/2)N^(4/5), hence C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(23/2)N^(4/5). Section8 supplies a classical Sylvester floor scheme, finite step certificates verified on all30030period cells and their tails, exact rational inequalities, and a simultaneous explicit power-error proof giving a prime in(x,(1091/1000)x] for EVERY real x>=2^200. Sections9--10 supply all guards, analytic tail N>=2^334, zero range0..196,6484 checked finite rows for197..2^30-1, and a reproduced3234-entry finite prime chain covering EVERY real argument2^18..2^201 to treat the ENTIRE middle2^30<=N<2^334. Each chain prime has independent trial division or a supplied proved Proth witness. Concavity, chain ratio coverage and the infinite analytic proof discharge every length. Thus for every epsilon>0 and all sufficiently large integer N, C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N. Four finite six-entry tuples compare numeric certified losses only. No prior verdict, accepted-result catalog, unproved external prime-gap theorem or circuit upper bound is a premise.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: For every ODD PRIME k>=3, the exact irreducible_prime(k) algorithm in family.py terminates in polynomial time in k and outputs a monic irreducible binary polynomial of degree k. field.md supplies the complete prime-degree construction and proof, including binary factor extraction, cyclotomic nonresidue lifting, Kummer extension and trace descent. This specializes a known Shoup construction and does not claim a new general irreducible-construction algorithm.

The complete finite certified losses(original,weighted,positive-exact,zero-deficit,compressed,new) are(1461,1437,1429,1413,1393,1257) at N=500,(2533,2493,2485,2485,2465,2265) at N=1000,(4513,4449,4433,4417,4397,4061) at N=2000,and(16809,16601,16577,16521,16501,15365) at N=10000. These compare certified losses, not actual optimal circuit sizes.

For EVERY integer N>=0 this SAME fixed total uniform P family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(23/2)N^(4/5). Sections8--10 supply the full floor-scheme/error/prime proof, analytic tail, zero range and finite transfers. The declared computation verifies all30030period cells of supplied step certificates,6484intervals for197..2^30-1 and3234prime-chain entries covering EVERY real argument2^18..2^201 with independent trial division or proved Proth witnesses. No untested infinite range is inferred from samples.

experiments.purpose: Exactly verify the supplied30030-period floor/step certificates, rational leading and power-error inequalities,6484small-length intervals,3234prime-chain entries and all retained foundational bounded field/threshold/reference/evaluator predicates.
